name: Gateway Arch
source: USGS St. Louis lidar (NAVD88 metres). USGS 3DEP public-domain lidar, Entwine Point Tiles: https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/usgs-lidar-public/USGS_LPC_MO_StLouis_2017_LAS_2018/ept.json
facts: The Gateway Arch is as wide as it is tall: 630 feet, about 192 metres, each way. It is the tallest monument in the United States.
It is covered in shiny stainless steel. Little egg-shaped tram cars ride up inside its legs to windows at the very top.
axes: +X east, +Y up, +Z south; metres = int16 * scale; y = 0 is the water level
order: random (the first N points are an even subsample)
